output.summary: Refactor app/main.py to bypass Pydantic model validation and serialization for all endpoints by returning plain dictionaries via FastAPI's JSONResponse. Specifically: 1) In create_note_endpoint, return JSONResponse(content=created_dict, status_code=201). 2) In read_note, return JSONResponse(content=note_dict, status_code=200). 3) In update_note_endpoint, return JSONResponse(content=updated_dict, status_code=200). 4) In list_notes_endpoint, continue returning the dict directly (already optimized). This eliminates the overhead of constructing Note Pydantic models and their subsequent serialization in the API layer for all operations, while preserving the exact JSON output structure required by the API contract.
